workstreams.title: Effects and motion graphics
workstreams.description: Visual effects, particles, celebrations, transitions and readable spectacle.

workstreams.title: Interface, HUD and interaction

workstreams.title: Audio, music and voice
workstreams.description: Sound identity, interactive music, dialogue, audio behavior and mixing.

workstreams.title: Quality assurance and test engineering
workstreams.description: Functional, regression, native input, compatibility and acceptance evidence.

workstreams.description: Observed comprehension, comfort, difficulty, enjoyment and research synthesis.

workstreams.title: Accessibility and inclusive play
workstreams.description: Accessible design, assistive technologies, inclusive input and actual acceptance.

workstreams.title: Localization and cultural adaptation

workstreams.title: Release, packaging and distribution
workstreams.description: Signing, packaging, release readiness, store materials and delivery evidence.

workstreams.description: Offline data safety, dependency provenance, permissions and security assurance.

workstreams.title: Marketing, community and player support
workstreams.description: Positioning, store presence, communications, discoverability and player support.

workstreams.title: Studio operations, rights and people
workstreams.description: Budget, rights, procurement, credits, staffing and production continuity.

workstreams.description: Future authorized local-network versus/co-op; implementation requires its own task.

workstreams.title: Online accounts and service infrastructure
workstreams.description: Outside current offline product: accounts, backends, matchmaking and hosted services.

workstreams.title: Commerce and monetization
workstreams.description: Outside current product: monetization requires a separately authorized opt-in target.

workstreams.title: Live service and product analytics
workstreams.description: Outside current offline product: live events, analytics pipelines and service operations.
